text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Heading into the cafeteria at lunchtime, 
I found Mayano Top Gun dispensing advice 
as usual.

text_block_list.name: Troubled Student
text_block_list.text:
—And so, if I fail this exam, 
it's going to be un-be-liev-a-bly bad...!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Uh-huh, uh-huh. So basically~, 
you want Maya to predict which questions 
are gonna be on the test, right?

text_block_list.name: Troubled Student
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Pretty please, 
with a cherry on top...!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: —Alright! Maya's got an idea!

text_block_list.name: Troubled Student
text_block_list.text:
A-As expected of Lady Mayano! 
So, what kind of questions should I—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, well... For starters, let's try 
a practice pop quiz from the workbook 
together!

text_block_list.name: Troubled Student
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Good work! Now then, let's have 
a look-see at your answers—

text_block_list.name: Troubled Student
text_block_list.text:
...It's an absolute trainwreck, so I'd 
really rather you didn't look too closely—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...Aha! Maya's got it all figured out!

text_block_list.name: Troubled Student
text_block_list.text: Ooh!? S-So this time for sure—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Next up! Time for a study session 
together♪

text_block_list.name: Troubled Student
text_block_list.text: What? Whaaat...!?

text_block_list.name: Troubled Student
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Drilling kanji is so tedious, 
I can't stand it...!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Let's make it a game, then! You and me— 
first one to finish a page wins!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Fufun, Maya's halfway through already! 
Looks like Maya's gonna win by a mile~!

text_block_list.name: Troubled Student
text_block_list.text: Wh-Why you... I'm not losing to that!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: —Alright! Maya's got it all figured out!

text_block_list.name: Troubled Student
text_block_list.text:
A-At last... Are you finally going to tell 
me 
what'll be on the test...?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Nope! I figured out who you are! 
Plus your best subjects and what problems 
you're good at!

text_block_list.name: Troubled Student
text_block_list.text:
H-Huh!? M-Me!? 
Not the test questions!?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, I already knew those... But I 
realized 
that's not the answer you actually need.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
'Cause you hate losing! Deep down, you 
really want to face this test head-on and 
pass, 
don't you?

text_block_list.name: Troubled Student
text_block_list.text:
I-I mean, yeah, but... 
I just don't have the confidence...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry! You can totally do it! 
'Cause Maya knows you've got what it 
takes!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Let's conquer this test together! 
Oh yeah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Rather than handing out easy answers, she 
stood by them 
and tackled the issues together. From then 
on, the attitudes 
of those seeking her advice began to 
shift, bit by bit—

text_block_list.name: Advice Seeker
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, Mayano. 
For talking through my form with me. 
And even sticking around through training.

text_block_list.name: Advice Seeker
text_block_list.text:
...I thought I'd hit my limit. 
But now... I feel like I've still got more 
in me!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous☆ Thanks to you, Mayano, 
the whole academy is overflowing with 
marvels★
choice_data_list:
The girls whose worries were solved look 
happy too.

The girls whose worries were solved look 
happy too.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. It's thanks to Marve-chin 
giving me that great nudge.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Having your problems vanish in a flash 
definitely feels great.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
But... if you clear them through your own 
power, 
it feels way, waaay better!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
So—Maya figured it out! 
What everyone really needs isn't 
just getting handed a quick answer—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
It's having someone by their side giving 
them a little push! 
That's what's truly important!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu... I knew it☆ 
I knew you'd reach that marvelous answer, 
Mayano★
choice_data_list:
You've finally "figured it out" in the 
truest sense.

You've finally "figured it out" in the 
truest sense.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu... I knew it☆ 
I knew you'd reach that marvelous answer, 
Mayano★
choice_data_list:
You've finally "figured it out" in the 
truest sense.

You've finally "figured it out" in the 
truest sense.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. Being able to do that is what 
they call a mature woman's big-hearted 
warmth, 
you know.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Feel free to come to me whenever you need 
advice. 
Maya's heart is about this big...! 
Su~per big and deep, after all!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, totally, right?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
If you've ever got worries, Maya's right 
here for you. 
Come see me anytime!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yup! Took a bit of a detour... but it was 
definitely a detour worth taking.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
This time for real... I copy! 
Maya's got it all figured out!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Sometimes you think you've "figured 
it out," 
when you haven't really "figured it out" 
at all, 
huh?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
But that's okay! Maya's gonna keep 
stacking up 
plenty more "figured it outs" from here on 
and grow into a real mature woman!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, flattery and worship 
won't get you anything extra, you know.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Though I don't mind staying by your side 
and lending a little hand. Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: !? Wh-Whoa, are you crying!?
choice_data_list:
No, it's just... I'm a little overwhelmed 
with gratitude...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
There, there. You're exhausted too, aren't 
you? 
Tell Maya all your troubles!
